summary: Completed first iteration testing of HangiFiltre web scraping application. Backend APIs are functional but scraping fails due to Playwright browser installation issue. Frontend UI works perfectly with proper error handling and responsive design.

critical_bugs.issue: Playwright browsers not properly installed - BrowserType.launch fails with 'Executable doesn't exist at /root/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell'

critical_bugs.error_details: Multiple attempts to install Playwright browsers failed. Backend service needs proper Playwright setup in container environment.
